spell:absolute-zero.name: Absolute Zero
spell:absolute-zero.reason: The art is a blue spiral of icy wind. Absolute Zero describes cold so complete it becomes its absence; the frozen vortex communicates the spell’s subject.

spell:absolution.name: Absolution
spell:absolution.reason: The image is a closed golden book with a white hand laid across its cover. Absolution removes a burden through a formal act of the Light, and the hand-and-book seal fits that rite.

spell:aegis.name: Aegis
spell:aegis.reason: The old art is a pair of crossing arcane strokes, which suggests a strike. This spell is a broad shield that refuses all incoming harm; the replacement visibly shows a blue shield.

spell:aegis-of-the-light.name: Aegis of the Light
spell:aegis-of-the-light.reason: A white shield in gold Light depicts the spell keeping a whole company above 0 Health when harm lands.

spell:afterlight.name: Afterlight
spell:afterlight.reason: The old art is a closed armored helmet, with no sign of lingering Light or a lingering benefit. The spell leaves a person more open to the next aid; the replacement shows a hand glowing with continuing restorative light.

spell:aftersight.name: Aftersight
spell:aftersight.reason: The purple arcane whirl is visibly magical rather than physical. Aftersight reads marks left on ley lines, so an arcane trace is an appropriate cue.

spell:amplify-magic.name: Amplify Magic
spell:amplify-magic.reason: The art is a blue starfield of magic. Amplify Magic opens a creature to magic in both directions, and the spreading arcane field communicates that exposure.

spell:anathema.name: Anathema
spell:anathema.reason: The old art is a warrior striking with a weapon. Anathema is a Light judgment that names a creature outside its protection; the replacement shows the Light issuing a direct command.

spell:ancestral-tide.name: Ancestral Tide
spell:ancestral-tide.reason: The old art is a green magical burst, with no ancestral presence. Ancestral Tide calls the shamans who came before; the replacement shows an ancestral, totemlike spirit emblem.

spell:annihilation.name: Annihilation
spell:annihilation.reason: The old art is a green figure-shaped beam. Annihilation spends the school’s full force on one target; the replacement shows a concentrated magical explosion.

spell:arcane-anchor.name: Arcane Anchor
spell:arcane-anchor.reason: The icon shows a curved blue leyline with a bright fixed point. Arcane Anchor holds a place still against movement through ley lines; the fixed point supports that use.

spell:arcane-barrage.name: Arcane Barrage
spell:arcane-barrage.reason: Two bright bolts cross the icon. Arcane Barrage lets unshaped power fly without a chosen target, which the crossing projectiles communicate.

spell:arcane-binding.name: Arcane Binding
spell:arcane-binding.reason: The old art shows a purple diagonal beam, which does not enclose anything. Arcane Binding is a cage that tightens as the prisoner resists; the replacement visibly shows chains closing around a target.

spell:arcane-brilliance.name: Arcane Brilliance
spell:arcane-brilliance.reason: A violet hand shaping arcane power fits the increased Mana capacity shared with the group.

spell:arcane-explosion.name: Arcane Explosion
spell:arcane-explosion.reason: A bright burst fills the image. Arcane Explosion releases power in every direction at once, which the expanding flash depicts.

spell:arcane-intellect.name: Arcane Intellect
spell:arcane-intellect.reason: A violet hand shaping arcane power fits the target gaining room for more Mana.

spell:arcane-missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
spell:arcane-missiles.reason: The old icon is a literal blue shield, which reads as defense. The spell launches repeated arcane bolts; the inspected Starfall artwork shows a volley of bright falling projectiles and communicates that action.

spell:arcane-nova.name: Arcane Nova
spell:arcane-nova.reason: The icon is a circular white blast. Arcane Nova releases unshaped power outward in every direction, matching the radial burst.

spell:arcane-seal.name: Arcane Seal
spell:arcane-seal.reason: An arcane spell sigil suits a ward placed on a named physical boundary.

spell:archmage.name: Archmage
spell:archmage.reason: A robed mage silhouette stands above a group. Archmage names a caster’s attained mastery, and the image clearly identifies a powerful mage.

spell:ash-assay.name: Ash Assay
spell:ash-assay.reason: The fire and ash icon fits a Shaman's examination of burned residue.

spell:ashfall.name: Ashfall
spell:ashfall.reason: Orange fiery streaks fall across dark ground, fitting Fire damage and ash that obscures the area.

spell:ashmantle.name: Ashmantle
spell:ashmantle.reason: An orange fire-edged shield depicts the mantle that protects the caster and burns melee attackers.

spell:aura-of-courage.name: Aura of Courage
spell:aura-of-courage.reason: Golden Light radiates from the center of the image. Aura of Courage turns the Light toward the mind and steadies nearby allies, matching the radiant morale effect.

spell:backburn.name: Backburn
spell:backburn.reason: An orange fireburst expands from its center, fitting the first burn leaping to another nearby creature.

spell:banish.name: Banish
spell:banish.reason: The old art is a green bolt, suggesting a damaging projectile. Banish sends the target through a door and holds it there; the replacement depicts a bright opening into another place.

spell:bargain.name: Bargain
spell:bargain.reason: The old art shows a green-clad fighter, unrelated to a warlock’s negotiation. The spell bargains with a being beyond the veil; the replacement shows a demonic figure and directly signals that exchange.

spell:barkskin.name: Barkskin
spell:barkskin.reason: The old art is a blue water-like wave. Barkskin puts bark on a person as protection; the replacement visibly shows a woody, thorned branch.

spell:barrier.name: Barrier
spell:barrier.reason: A blue magical shield fits an area that grants Ward without physically blocking movement or sight.

spell:beacon-of-light.name: Beacon of Light
spell:beacon-of-light.reason: A paladin is surrounded by a bright golden halo. Beacon of Light marks one person as the destination for the paladin’s later healing, matching the visible beacon.

spell:blackout.name: Blackout
spell:blackout.reason: A dark violet shape sweeps across the image. Blackout makes darkness stand where light was, matching the image’s enveloping shadow.

spell:blast-wave.name: Blast Wave
spell:blast-wave.reason: An orange radial blast depicts Fire damage spreading outward and pushing creatures away.

spell:blazing-speed.name: Blazing Speed
spell:blazing-speed.reason: The old art is a blue shield, which reads as defense. Blazing Speed is a sudden burst of movement that leaves fire behind; the replacement shows a fast streak of flame.

spell:blessing-of-freedom.name: Blessing of Freedom
spell:blessing-of-freedom.reason: The old art is a blue blade and shield. Blessing of Freedom lets someone continue moving; the replacement’s feather conveys lightness and release.

spell:blessing-of-kings.name: Blessing of Kings
spell:blessing-of-kings.reason: A gold shield bearing a formal emblem fits the Boon to Resilience Tests granted to each target.

spell:blessing-of-might.name: Blessing of Might
spell:blessing-of-might.reason: The icon is a golden book or writ. Blessing of Might is a bestowed blessing before strenuous action, and the written emblem reads as a formal grant.

spell:blizzard.name: Blizzard
spell:blizzard.reason: The old art is a set of tight chains, which suggests restraint. Blizzard rains ice over an area while the caster sustains it; the replacement shows a swirling ice storm.

spell:blood-pact.name: Blood Pact
spell:blood-pact.reason: A green demon burns inside the image. Blood Pact takes mana from a demon and leaves it alive, so the demonic subject fits the spell’s source.

spell:bloodboil.name: Bloodboil
spell:bloodboil.reason: Large red droplets fill the icon. Bloodboil moves what is inside people across an area; the blood imagery directly signals the effect.

spell:bloom.name: Bloom
spell:bloom.reason: Green mushrooms and new growth spread over the image. Bloom calls growth up all at once, matching the sudden vegetation.

spell:borrowed-voice.name: Borrowed Voice
spell:borrowed-voice.reason: The shadow themed icon supports a temporary alteration of the speaker's voice.

spell:carrion-swarm.name: Carrion Swarm
spell:carrion-swarm.reason: A flock of dark winged creatures fills the icon. Carrion Swarm sends many small dark things through the area, matching the swarm.

spell:cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
spell:cataclysm.reason: The art shows a fiery break in the land. Cataclysm is the destructive spell that broke Draenor, so the scorched terrain conveys its scale.

spell:celestial-alignment.name: Celestial Alignment
spell:celestial-alignment.reason: The old art is a purple slash, with no celestial or natural pattern. Celestial Alignment brings moon and wild power into agreement; the replacement depicts an astral storm.

spell:chain-lightning.name: Chain Lightning
spell:chain-lightning.reason: A blue electrical bolt forks across the image. Chain Lightning jumps from one target to another, exactly the branching action shown.

spell:chaos-bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
spell:chaos-bolt.reason: Green fel energy flies from a warlock’s hand. Chaos Bolt throws fel power at a marked target; the icon shows both fel color and a directed projectile.

spell:chaos-lash.name: Chaos Lash
spell:chaos-lash.reason: A horned red beast face fills the frame, with a streak of force cutting across it. Chaos Lash is a violent fel strike that tears into a target; the demonic face and slash convey that assault.

spell:chaosbrand.name: Chaosbrand
spell:chaosbrand.reason: A spectral figure is held in green shadow. Chaosbrand marks a target for destruction, and the ghostly mark fits the lasting curse.

spell:chilblain.name: Chilblain
spell:chilblain.reason: The old art is a shield, though the spell freezes the hands and arms until a weapon can no longer be held. The replacement shows an icy burst striking a target.

spell:cinderburst.name: Cinderburst
spell:cinderburst.reason: The old art is a blue ice shard, the wrong element for white cinders. Cinderburst throws a fistful of hot sparks; the replacement clearly shows a burning projectile.

spell:cinderfall.name: Cinderfall
spell:cinderfall.reason: Several orange fiery streaks descend, matching the delayed Fire fall over an area.

spell:cinderpact.name: Cinderpact
spell:cinderpact.reason: A gold-and-orange fire seal evokes binding an existing Immolate burn into one final strike.

spell:cleanse.name: Cleanse
spell:cleanse.reason: Pale blue curls sweep across the icon. Cleanse names a harmful effect and asks it to leave, which the clearing swirl conveys.

spell:cold-cipher.name: Cold Cipher
spell:cold-cipher.reason: The old art is a plain snowflake, which does not communicate an encoded sentence. Cold Cipher writes meaning into the structure of cold; the replacement visibly shows a rune.

spell:cold-front.name: Cold Front
spell:cold-front.reason: A bright ice crystal bursts against dark blue. Cold Front creates a local pocket of severe cold; the image reads as an abrupt cold front.

spell:cold-snap.name: Cold Snap
spell:cold-snap.reason: A frozen hand is raised in the center. Cold Snap targets the caster’s hands and frees their feet, so the image directly supports the effect.

spell:cold-trail.name: Cold Trail
spell:cold-trail.reason: The old art is an orange sunburst from a fire-resistance totem. Cold Trail records the altered ice left behind by movement; the replacement shows a field of blue ice.

spell:coldforge.name: Coldforge
spell:coldforge.reason: Several blue ice blades are being shaped together. Coldforge holds water and cold in a formed shape, matching the forged ice.

spell:coldsleep.name: Coldsleep
spell:coldsleep.reason: A blue block of ice surrounds the subject. Coldsleep places an entire company down in ice, so the enclosing ice block fits.

spell:commune.name: Commune
spell:commune.reason: A luminous wild beast face depicts asking the land and nearby animals what happened there.

spell:compel.name: Compel
spell:compel.reason: A vivid green eye dominates the icon. Compel lays a commanding name over a demon’s own; the direct, staring eye signals domination.

spell:condemnation.name: Condemnation
spell:condemnation.reason: A radiant figure shines over a group. Condemnation reads a mark on one creature over everyone near it, and the image shows a public holy judgment.

spell:cone-of-cold.name: Cone of Cold
spell:cone-of-cold.reason: The old art is a shield, suggesting protection. Cone of Cold pours a wedge of freezing force in front of the caster; the replacement shows cold energy bursting outward.

spell:conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
spell:conflagrate.reason: An orange target engulfed in flame fits consuming an existing Immolate burn for stronger Fire damage.

spell:conflagration.name: Conflagration
spell:conflagration.reason: The old art is an icy figure, unrelated to fire. Conflagration gathers all the caster’s fires onto one target; the replacement shows a concentrated flame.

spell:conjure-water.name: Conjure Water
spell:conjure-water.reason: The old art is a pointed ice blast, which looks like an attack. Conjure Water draws drinkable water from the air; the replacement shows a hand pouring clear water.

spell:consecration.name: Consecration
spell:consecration.reason: Gold Holy light radiates across an area, fitting ground that damages enemies beginning their turns there.

spell:consume.name: Consume
spell:consume.reason: A purple vortex pulls toward its center. Consume spends a bound demon for its power; the inward pull depicts something being consumed.

spell:contagion.name: Contagion
spell:contagion.reason: A diseased creature spreads out from the center. Contagion places blight in an area and lets it spread, matching the infected image.

spell:contract.name: Contract
spell:contract.reason: The old art is a pair of glowing eyes, suggesting surveillance. Contract is the agreement at the heart of warlock practice; the replacement is visibly a book of terms.

spell:convocation.name: Convocation
spell:convocation.reason: An orange carved elemental emblem fills the frame. Convocation invites the elements to their own country; the ritual emblem supports the act of summoning them.

spell:crucible.name: Crucible
spell:crucible.reason: A contained curl of orange heat evokes the sustained furnace that punishes metal armor and weapons.

spell:cure-blight.name: Cure Blight
spell:cure-blight.reason: A green plague skull being overcome by cleansing light fits ending poison and disease.

spell:cure-poison.name: Cure Poison
spell:cure-poison.reason: The old art is a green mouth full of fangs, which depicts poison as an attack. Cure Poison removes venom from a person; the replacement shows a cleansing swirl.

spell:curse-of-agony.name: Curse of Agony
spell:curse-of-agony.reason: A dark face contorted inside purple shadow depicts the ongoing pain inflicted each turn.

spell:curse-of-doom.name: Curse of Doom
spell:curse-of-doom.reason: A skull and black plague imagery dominate the art. Curse of Doom is fel written on a creature to read itself out, matching the deathly mark.

spell:curse-of-exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
spell:curse-of-exhaustion.reason: The icon shows a distressed mind under a dense gray pattern. Curse of Exhaustion weighs on its target until lifted, matching the image’s mental burden.

spell:curse-of-ruin.name: Curse of Ruin
spell:curse-of-ruin.reason: A burning spirit is trapped in purple shadow. Curse of Ruin is a hidden destructive clause, and the image conveys a lasting hostile presence.

spell:curse-of-the-elements.name: Curse of the Elements
spell:curse-of-the-elements.reason: A grim ward emblem sits over the image. Curse of the Elements attacks a creature’s protections, so the ward motif matches the defenses being targeted.

spell:curse-of-tongues.name: Curse of Tongues
spell:curse-of-tongues.reason: A ghostly shape is wrapped in blue darkness. Curse of Tongues scrambles spoken words; the haunting figure fits an affliction that acts through speech.

spell:curse-of-weakness.name: Curse of Weakness
spell:curse-of-weakness.reason: A pale, drained face fills the icon. Curse of Weakness removes strength from the target, matching the visibly weakened figure.

spell:cyclone.name: Cyclone
spell:cyclone.reason: A green tornado wraps inward around a point. Cyclone lifts and encloses one creature in air, matching the depicted vortex.

spell:dampen-magic.name: Dampen Magic
spell:dampen-magic.reason: A blue magical shield depicts Ward against the named school rather than a physical wall.

spell:dark-passage.name: Dark Passage
spell:dark-passage.reason: A golden portal-like flare opens through shadow. Dark Passage moves the entire party through a door to another place, matching the opening.

spell:darkward.name: Darkward
spell:darkward.reason: A jagged violet ward emblem depicts the group protected against Shadow and its first hit.

spell:death-coil.name: Death Coil
spell:death-coil.reason: Green deathly energy coils around a skull. Death Coil drains a target and gives the stolen life to the caster; the skull and spiral fit the transfer.

spell:deep-winter.name: Deep Winter
spell:deep-winter.reason: A blue snowflake fills the icon. Deep Winter lays maintained cold over an area, directly matching the winter symbol.

spell:deepwinter.name: Deepwinter
spell:deepwinter.reason: A blue faceted ice crystal evokes the pocket of winter that travels with the party, freezing water and preserving supplies.

spell:deliverance.name: Deliverance
spell:deliverance.reason: A gold cross and radiant figure fill the icon. Deliverance reaches a whole village with the Light, matching the visible holy rescue.

spell:demonheart.name: Demonheart
spell:demonheart.reason: The image shows a demon’s face within a ritual frame. Demonheart brings the warlock closer to the being they bargained with, matching the demonic subject.

spell:demonhide.name: Demonhide
spell:demonhide.reason: The old art is a pair of glowing eyes. Demonhide covers the warlock in borrowed demonic skin; the replacement shows a demon’s face and form.

spell:demonic-circle.name: Demonic Circle
spell:demonic-circle.reason: A green magic ring opens on the ground, fitting the drawn circle that binds demons standing inside it.

spell:demonic-gateway.name: Demonic Gateway
spell:demonic-gateway.reason: A bright green portal rim surrounds a dark passage, fitting paired gateways that carry travelers through the Nether.

spell:demonic-sight.name: Demonic Sight
spell:demonic-sight.reason: The old art is a bloody slash across a skull. Demonic Sight lends the warlock a pair of otherworldly eyes; the replacement is a large, unmistakable eye.

spell:descent.name: Descent
spell:descent.reason: A violet-green spiral descends into a central opening. Descent brings a force down from the Nether into the world, matching the downward pull.

spell:detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
spell:detect-magic.reason: Blue stars and runes cover the field. Detect Magic reveals the magical contents of a room, matching the arcane reading motif.

spell:devotion-aura.name: Devotion Aura
spell:devotion-aura.reason: A bright shield is centered in a blue ring. Devotion Aura protects people standing near the paladin, matching the shielded aura.

spell:disintegration.name: Disintegration
spell:disintegration.reason: A purple arcane beam cuts across the icon. Disintegration applies arcane force to break a target down, matching the destructive ray.

spell:dispersion.name: Dispersion
spell:dispersion.reason: Purple pieces pull away from a central point. Dispersion stops the priest from being a body for a time, matching the visibly scattered form.

spell:displacement.name: Displacement
spell:displacement.reason: A spectral creature is caught in a blue spatial swirl. Displacement exchanges two positions through ley lines, and the shifting image supports that movement.

spell:distant-mind.name: Distant Mind
spell:distant-mind.reason: A green mind-like silhouette looks outward. Distant Mind extends perception beyond the horizon, matching the projected view.

spell:divine-shield.name: Divine Shield
spell:divine-shield.reason: A radiant shield occupies the entire icon. Divine Shield refuses harm on a paladin’s behalf, so the subject is an exact match.

spell:dominate.name: Dominate
spell:dominate.reason: The old art is a red draining tendril, suggesting damage. Dominate places an order in another creature’s mind; the replacement depicts direct shadow control.

spell:doom-bolt.name: Doom Bolt
spell:doom-bolt.reason: Several orange bolts fly toward a target. Doom Bolt is a slow projectile pulled out of the Nether, matching the directed bolts.

spell:doomfall.name: Doomfall
spell:doomfall.reason: The old art is a green plague burst, and the prior proposal was a literal city portal. Doomfall is a fel fire that rains across ground and keeps burning; the replacement shows a spread of falling green fire.

spell:doomfire.name: Doomfire
spell:doomfire.reason: A green Fel flame depicts the burning ground that damages creatures and restores demons.

spell:drain-life.name: Drain Life
spell:drain-life.reason: The old art is a green hammer-like weapon. Drain Life opens a line from the target to the caster and lets life run through it; the replacement shows energy being siphoned.

spell:drain-soul.name: Drain Soul
spell:drain-soul.reason: A purple claw grips a living target. Drain Soul pulls steadily on what keeps a creature alive, matching the grasping drain.

spell:dream-theatre.name: Dream Theatre
spell:dream-theatre.reason: The dreamlike shadow icon suits an illusion staged in a sleeping target's dream.

spell:dreamsight.name: Dreamsight
spell:dreamsight.reason: Stars and rings overlay a dark landscape. Dreamsight reads the Dream as a map of the world, matching the astral mapping image.

spell:dreamway.name: Dreamway
spell:dreamway.reason: The old art is a yellow mask, not a route. Dreamway travels through the Emerald Dream beneath the world; the replacement shows an opening into another place.

spell:earth-shock.name: Earth Shock
spell:earth-shock.reason: A yellow crack splits the ground. Earth Shock sends a jolt through the earth into a target, matching the ground fracture.

spell:earthfast.name: Earthfast
spell:earthfast.reason: The old art is a blue spear. Earthfast makes the ground hold someone in place; the replacement depicts a grounded binding effect.

spell:earthguard.name: Earthguard
spell:earthguard.reason: A green magical shield fits the one spell that the earth refuses on the caster’s behalf.

spell:earthskin.name: Earthskin
spell:earthskin.reason: A rocky figure in green Nature light fits hardened skin, temporary Health, and slower movement.

spell:elemental-convergence.name: Elemental Convergence
spell:elemental-convergence.reason: Fire and lightning strike broken earth together, fitting a destructive convergence of elements across an area.

spell:elunes-answer.name: Elune's Answer
spell:elunes-answer.reason: The old art is a purple arcane explosion. Elune answers a rare, direct prayer; the replacement shows luminous moonlight.

spell:ember-road.name: Ember Road
spell:ember-road.reason: The old art is a blue projectile. Ember Road transports the shaman through places where fire already burns; the replacement shows flame streaming with movement and avoids suggesting a city portal.

spell:ember-skin.name: Ember Skin
spell:ember-skin.reason: An orange fire-edged shield depicts Fire protection around the caster.

spell:emberflight.name: Emberflight
spell:emberflight.reason: Blue fire streams behind a moving figure. Emberflight makes the caster come apart and move as fire; the streak depicts the sudden fiery movement.

spell:emberlash.name: Emberlash
spell:emberlash.reason: An orange flame curls into a hooked lash. Emberlash leaves burning embers attached to its target, matching the grasping fire.

spell:enslave-demon.name: Enslave Demon
spell:enslave-demon.reason: The icon depicts a demon under a controlling sigil. Enslave Demon places the warlock’s name over the demon’s own, matching the controlled figure.

spell:entangling-vines.name: Entangling Vines
spell:entangling-vines.reason: The old art is a glowing face, not vegetation. Entangling Vines roots through the soil and holds creatures in place; the replacement visibly shows a thorned plant.

spell:entombment.name: Entombment
spell:entombment.reason: The old art is a snowflake burst, and the prior proposal is a skull wearing frost armor. Entombment seals one living person inside unmoving ice; the replacement depicts a solid wall of ice, the closest available image of an enclosing ice prison.

spell:entropy.name: Entropy
spell:entropy.reason: A purple-black void opens inside green darkness, fitting a Shadow strike that unravels a target and leaves nothing behind.

spell:everburn.name: Everburn
spell:everburn.reason: A self-contained orange flame fits a Fire effect that needs no fuel and cannot be put out ordinarily.

spell:exacting-measure.name: Exacting Measure
spell:exacting-measure.reason: The arcane icon marks a spell that measures dimensions and counted contents precisely.

spell:exorcism.name: Exorcism
spell:exorcism.reason: The old art is a paw print, suggesting a beast. Exorcism argues against the spirit added to a creature; the replacement shows an undead face being confronted by the Light.

spell:exsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
spell:exsanguinate.reason: Purple energy is pulled from a living figure. Exsanguinate opens a drain the rest of the way and empties the target, matching the siphon.

spell:eyes-of-kilrogg.name: Eyes of Kilrogg
spell:eyes-of-kilrogg.reason: The old art is a blade, even though the spell gives the warlock a vision through an eye. The replacement visibly depicts an eye.

spell:faceless.name: Faceless
spell:faceless.reason: A blue human face is washed out by magic. Faceless lets a creature wear another person’s appearance, matching the altered face.

spell:fade.name: Fade
spell:fade.reason: A figure dissolves into violet and blue light. Fade makes the priest hard to hold in the mind, matching the vanishing form.

spell:faerie-fire.name: Faerie Fire
spell:faerie-fire.reason: Pink-violet light clings to a small creature or tree. Faerie Fire marks a creature with light that cannot be brushed away, matching the clinging glow.

spell:farsight.name: Farsight
spell:farsight.reason: The old art is a close purple blink of arcane energy. Farsight looks far along the ley lines; the replacement shows a distant horizon.

spell:farstep.name: Farstep
spell:farstep.reason: The old art is a portrait of a focused face. Farstep is an extended magical step out of a room; the replacement shows a bright spatial streak associated with blinking between places.

spell:fear.name: Fear
spell:fear.reason: A horned demonic face fills the square. Fear shows its target the thing it fears, and the threatening face conveys that effect.

spell:fel-armor.name: Fel Armor
spell:fel-armor.reason: A green armored shield with a demonic face depicts Ward against Fel and Shadow.

spell:fel-bolt.name: Fel Bolt
spell:fel-bolt.reason: A concentrated green projectile depicts the Fel bolt and its Ward-reducing impact.

spell:fel-covenant.name: Fel Covenant
spell:fel-covenant.reason: The old art shows crossed weapons, not an agreement. Fel Covenant offers a bargain to an entire company; the replacement depicts a demonic pact.

spell:fel-surety.name: Fel Surety
spell:fel-surety.reason: The demonic pact icon fits a Warlock's temporary promise to pay a bound demon's Power cost.

spell:fel-tether.name: Fel Tether
spell:fel-tether.reason: The old art is a single weapon-like slash. Fel Tether pays one creature’s chain out to those nearby; the replacement visibly shows binding chains.

spell:felfire-aura.name: Felfire Aura
spell:felfire-aura.reason: A circular green Fel flame depicts damage radiating from the caster each turn.

spell:felscript.name: Felscript
spell:felscript.reason: The old art is a blue lightning creature. Felscript stores warlock knowledge in writing; the replacement is visibly a book.

spell:felstep.name: Felstep
spell:felstep.reason: The old art is a demon’s face, with no movement. Felstep moves the warlock through the Nether; the replacement depicts a portal-like phase shift.

spell:fire-nova.name: Fire Nova
spell:fire-nova.reason: A bright orange ring of fire expands from its center, matching the Fire nova that knocks creatures down.

spell:fire-shield.name: Fire Shield
spell:fire-shield.reason: An orange fire-edged shield depicts protection that burns a melee attacker.

spell:fire-ward.name: Fire Ward
spell:fire-ward.reason: An orange shield edged with fire depicts Ward that stops incoming Fire damage.

spell:fireball.name: Fireball
spell:fireball.reason: A bright orange fireball leaves the center of the icon. Fireball throws a mote of flame that bursts on impact; the image depicts that action.

spell:firebrand.name: Firebrand
spell:firebrand.reason: A smith’s hammer and orange fire depict placing a burning enchantment on a weapon.

spell:firebreak.name: Firebreak
spell:firebreak.reason: An orange fire-edged shield depicts the line that suppresses Fire effects and protects creatures crossing it.

spell:firelands.name: Firelands
spell:firelands.reason: An orange ring of fire evokes the rift through which Firelands burns over the area.

spell:firewake.name: Firewake
spell:firewake.reason: An orange flame depicts the burning area that spreads from an existing Wildfire.

spell:firewalk.name: Firewalk
spell:firewalk.reason: The old art is a green ward symbol. Firewalk moves through flames rather than stopping them; the replacement shows a fast streak of fire.

spell:fissure.name: Fissure
spell:fissure.reason: The old art is a pair of stone faces. Fissure pulls already-loose ground apart; the replacement shows a violent break in the earth.

spell:flame-burst.name: Flame Burst
spell:flame-burst.reason: A single orange flame streaks diagonally across the square. Flame Burst is a directed fire strike, matching the fiery projectile.

spell:flame-shock.name: Flame Shock
spell:flame-shock.reason: A creature is engulfed by orange flame. Flame Shock drives fire into a target so it keeps burning, matching the impact.

spell:flameforge.name: Flameforge
spell:flameforge.reason: The old art is a green lance of light, with no heat or forge. Flameforge holds heat at a precise working temperature; the replacement shows a smith’s hammer wreathed in flame.

spell:flamesong.name: Flamesong
spell:flamesong.reason: A weapon struck in orange fire fits the Fire damage granted to each target’s attacks.

spell:flamestrike.name: Flamestrike
spell:flamestrike.reason: An orange radial fireburst fits Fire damage across the area and lingering ground flame.

spell:flare.name: Flare
spell:flare.reason: A red streak flares brightly against a dark field. Flare hangs a light above an area; the bright airborne streak reads as a signal flare.

spell:flash-of-light.name: Flash of Light
spell:flash-of-light.reason: Golden rays flash outward from a bright point. Flash of Light is a small, fast mercy; the brief holy flash fits its quick healing.

spell:flashover.name: Flashover
spell:flashover.reason: A red-orange fireburst blooms outward. Flashover releases fire already inside a target; the explosive flame matches the sudden ignition.

spell:forge-flame.name: Forge Flame
spell:forge-flame.reason: A hammer works a glowing piece of metal. Forge Flame holds heat at an exact working temperature, directly matching the smithing image.

spell:frost-armor.name: Frost Armor
spell:frost-armor.reason: A skull wears a solid blue frost shell. Frost Armor puts protective ice over the caster’s clothes, and the armored skull depicts that defense.

spell:frost-nova.name: Frost Nova
spell:frost-nova.reason: The old art is a handful of pointed shards, suggesting projectiles. Frost Nova freezes the floor and everyone standing on it; the replacement shows a radial burst of ice.

spell:frost-ward.name: Frost Ward
spell:frost-ward.reason: The old art is a snowflake explosion, which reads as an attack. Frost Ward lays a shell of counter-cold over someone; the replacement visibly depicts a protective shield.

spell:frostbind.name: Frostbind
spell:frostbind.reason: A figure encased in jagged blue ice depicts Frost damage that can Stun the target.

spell:frostbite.name: Frostbite
spell:frostbite.reason: A blue orb is ringed in jagged frost. Frostbite freezes a creature’s blood rather than throwing ice at it; the frozen core fits that internal cold.

spell:frostbolt.name: Frostbolt
spell:frostbolt.reason: A long blue shard points toward its target. Frostbolt throws a shard of ice and spreads cold at impact, matching the projectile.

spell:frostshroud.name: Frostshroud
spell:frostshroud.reason: Sharp blue crystals cover the square. Frostshroud spreads thin cold protection over a company, and the icy covering suggests that shared shell.

spell:frostwake.name: Frostwake
spell:frostwake.reason: A wave of pale blue ice fits the Frost damage left running on a target under Winter’s Chill.

spell:frozen-ground.name: Frozen Ground
spell:frozen-ground.reason: Blue ice spreads in a broad layer along the ground. Frozen Ground makes an area difficult and cold underfoot, matching the frozen surface.

spell:frozen-rune.name: Frozen Rune
spell:frozen-rune.reason: A bright icy glyph stands against blue light. Frozen Rune lays a marked cold effect, and the visible rune matches the named object.

spell:gate.name: Gate
spell:gate.reason: A violet curved opening arcs through the center. Gate holds a door open between places, matching the portal shape.

spell:gentle-verdict.name: Gentle Verdict
spell:gentle-verdict.reason: The Holy protection icon fits a judgment that restrains rather than harms its target.

spell:ghost-wolf.name: Ghost Wolf
spell:ghost-wolf.reason: A blue spirit wolf is centered in the icon. Ghost Wolf lends the shaman a wolf shape for travel, matching the form exactly.

spell:glacial-spike.name: Glacial Spike
spell:glacial-spike.reason: A large ice spike points down from above. Glacial Spike is drawn out over a turn and driven through a target, matching the heavy shard.

spell:glaciate.name: Glaciate
spell:glaciate.reason: The old art is a lone shard, and the prior proposal is an armored skull. Glaciate suspends a creature inside ice; the replacement depicts solid ice as an enclosing barrier.

spell:glacier.name: Glacier
spell:glacier.reason: A mass of blue ice surges forward. Glacier sends moving ice at the pace of natural ice, matching the advancing formation.

spell:grand-lexicon.name: Grand Lexicon
spell:grand-lexicon.reason: The arcane knowledge icon suits temporary comprehension of a language supplied by another speaker.

spell:grave-coil.name: Grave Coil
spell:grave-coil.reason: A green deathly soul and dark coil depict Shadow damage that returns Health to the caster or heals undead.

spell:graveblight.name: Graveblight
spell:graveblight.reason: A corpse-like face is covered in decay. Graveblight tells the ground nothing should grow again, matching the undead blight.

spell:grove.name: Grove
spell:grove.reason: The old art is a purple figure in a rocklike scene. Grove closes a thicket around a company; the replacement visibly shows woody branches and thorns.

spell:gust-of-wind.name: Gust of Wind
spell:gust-of-wind.reason: The old art is a gray hammer. Gust of Wind drives air in one direction; the replacement shows a blue stream of wind.

spell:hailstorm.name: Hailstorm
spell:hailstorm.reason: The old art is a purple star field, not hail. Hailstorm turns cold water to falling stone; the replacement depicts sharp ice shards.

spell:hallowed-ground.name: Hallowed Ground
spell:hallowed-ground.reason: A golden shield stands over an area. Hallowed Ground claims a place and keeps it safe, matching the protective holy mark.

spell:halo.name: Halo
spell:halo.reason: A golden ring radiates outward. Halo travels out and returns, matching the circular path.

spell:halt.name: Halt
spell:halt.reason: An orange clock face marks creatures being held outside action and harm for a turn.

spell:hammer-of-justice.name: Hammer of Justice
spell:hammer-of-justice.reason: The old art is a horned demon face. Hammer of Justice drops the weight of the Light on one moving target; the replacement visibly depicts a hammer of holy force.

spell:haven.name: Haven
spell:haven.reason: The old art is crossed swords, which implies a fight. Haven makes a place where nothing happens and keeps it safe; the replacement depicts a protective shield.

spell:healing-rain.name: Healing Rain
spell:healing-rain.reason: A blue totem pouring water depicts healing that reaches allies standing in an area.

spell:healing-wave.name: Healing Wave
spell:healing-wave.reason: The old art is a gray void coil, which suggests neither water nor aid. Healing Wave pours water and life into one person; the replacement shows a green healing current flowing from a hand.

spell:health-funnel.name: Health Funnel
spell:health-funnel.reason: A dark hand reaching through green light evokes Health being passed from the caster to the target.

spell:heat-mirage.name: Heat Mirage
spell:heat-mirage.reason: The fire icon communicates the heat shimmer used to distort distant sight.

spell:hellbind.name: Hellbind
spell:hellbind.reason: The old art is a dark decay bloom. Hellbind controls a demon already banished; the replacement shows chains holding a target, matching restraint and control.

spell:hellfire.name: Hellfire
spell:hellfire.reason: A tall green Fel flame erupts across the ground, depicting damage that burns everything nearby, including the caster.

spell:hellquake.name: Hellquake
spell:hellquake.reason: Green Fel energy strikes the ground in a broad blast, fitting the quake’s Fel damage and Stun.

spell:hex.name: Hex
spell:hex.reason: A green frog stares out of the icon. Hex turns its target into an animal, matching the classic frog transformation.

spell:hoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost
spell:hoarfrost.reason: Blue ice shards spread across the image. Hoarfrost starts in the ground and spreads outward, matching the frozen spread.

spell:holy-brand.name: Holy Brand
spell:holy-brand.reason: A golden shaft of Light falls across the scene. Holy Brand sets the target apart with a visible mark of the Light, matching the radiant branding.

spell:holy-fire.name: Holy Fire
spell:holy-fire.reason: The old icon is green meteors, which reads as corrupted nature/fire rather than holy magic. The inspected replacement is a radiant golden sunburst, matching the spell’s light that burns its target.

spell:holy-light.name: Holy Light
spell:holy-light.reason: The old art is a clock face, which suggests borrowed time rather than healing. Holy Light channels the Light into another person’s wounds; the replacement shows a glowing hand giving aid.

spell:holy-nova.name: Holy Nova
spell:holy-nova.reason: A golden sunburst expands from the center. Holy Nova releases Light in every direction while distinguishing allies, matching the radial radiance.

spell:holy-ward.name: Holy Ward
spell:holy-ward.reason: A white shield in gold Light directly depicts Ward against Shadow and Fel.

spell:holy-wrath.name: Holy Wrath
spell:holy-wrath.reason: The old art is a helmet, which suggests armor. Holy Wrath releases Light downward and outward; the replacement depicts a radiant blast.

spell:horrify.name: Horrify
spell:horrify.reason: A shadowed face stares from the icon. Horrify shows a creature what it fears, and the threatening face supports that effect.

spell:howl-of-terror.name: Howl of Terror
spell:howl-of-terror.reason: A creature opens its mouth in a howl. Howl of Terror sends a sound from the Nether that frightens nearby creatures, matching the image.

spell:hymn.name: Hymn
spell:hymn.reason: The old art is an open hand. Hymn is sung aloud and recovers people together; the replacement depicts a harp and communicates music.

spell:ice-barrage.name: Ice Barrage
spell:ice-barrage.reason: The old art is a blue orb, not ammunition. Ice Barrage sends a spread of ice projectiles; the replacement shows multiple sharp shards.

spell:ice-barrier.name: Ice Barrier
spell:ice-barrier.reason: The old art is a dark orb, not a barrier. Ice Barrier holds a thick layer of ice between the caster and blows; the replacement visibly shows a wall of ice.

spell:ice-block.name: Ice Block
spell:ice-block.reason: The old art is a single purple shard. Ice Block encases the mage and removes them from the fight; the replacement shows a solid wall of enclosing ice.

spell:ice-lance.name: Ice Lance
spell:ice-lance.reason: The old art is a blue ring, with no thrown object. Ice Lance throws a splinter of ice; the replacement is a sharp shard in flight.

spell:ice-spear.name: Ice Spear
spell:ice-spear.reason: The old art is a water elemental, suggesting a summoned creature. Ice Spear drives one long piece of ice through a target; the replacement shows a large pointed ice spike.

spell:icefall.name: Icefall
spell:icefall.reason: The old art is a water elemental, but Icefall is heavy ice made aloft and dropped by gravity. The replacement shows an ice storm falling from above.

spell:icehold.name: Icehold
spell:icehold.reason: The old art is a flowing-water creature. Icehold builds ice as a structure; the replacement visibly depicts a wall of ice.

spell:icelock.name: Icelock
spell:icelock.reason: The old art is a dark blue orb. Icelock throws a ring of cold to stop pursuers; the replacement visibly depicts a ring of frost.

spell:icespan.name: Icespan
spell:icespan.reason: The old art is an eye-like rune. Icespan creates a step of ice ahead of each foot; the replacement depicts a connected sheet of ice.

spell:icevein-passage.name: Icevein Passage
spell:icevein-passage.reason: The frost and ice icon fits a temporary route across a frozen water surface.

spell:icewalk.name: Icewalk
spell:icewalk.reason: The old art is a golden time symbol. Icewalk forms ice beneath each step and lets it melt behind; the replacement shows a track of ice.

spell:immolate.name: Immolate
spell:immolate.reason: The old art is green fel flame striking the ground. Immolate keeps one target burning while the warlock maintains attention; the replacement depicts a figure engulfed in ordinary fire.

spell:immolation.name: Immolation
spell:immolation.reason: The caster’s silhouette is surrounded by fire. Immolation burns the caster while leaving their carried things alone, matching the self-centered flames.

spell:incinerate.name: Incinerate
spell:incinerate.reason: A face is consumed by orange flame. Incinerate is unreasonable warlock fire, matching the image of a target engulfed in heat.

spell:insect-swarm.name: Insect Swarm
spell:insect-swarm.reason: A group of green insects fills the frame. Insect Swarm summons many small creatures, matching the visible swarm.

spell:intercession.name: Intercession
spell:intercession.reason: The old art is a golden circular sigil, with no one stepping between danger and its target. Intercession takes a hit for another person; the replacement depicts a shield in the way.

spell:invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell:invisibility.reason: Blue horizontal light bends around a disappearing figure. Invisibility makes light go around someone; the image shows that distortion.

spell:killing-frost.name: Killing Frost
spell:killing-frost.reason: The old art is a dark hypnotic spiral. Killing Frost calls existing cold back into a creature; the replacement depicts a sharp frost impact.

spell:killing-winter.name: Killing Winter
spell:killing-winter.reason: A blue snowflake bursts into sharp points. Killing Winter gathers all the mage’s cold into one place, matching the concentrated frost.

spell:kindle.name: Kindle
spell:kindle.reason: The old art is a screaming fel-fire face. Kindle lights or puts out a campfire and has no creature target; the replacement shows a simple orange flame.

spell:landslide.name: Landslide
spell:landslide.reason: The old art is an orange explosion, not a moving hillside. Landslide makes a hill move; the replacement depicts earth breaking loose.

spell:levitate.name: Levitate
spell:levitate.reason: The old art is a green hand with a weapon, suggesting a strike. Levitate lifts the target from the ground; the replacement’s feather clearly signals floating.

spell:ley-cage.name: Ley Cage
spell:ley-cage.reason: Purple geometric arcs form a bounded magical field, fitting a cage that lets its prisoner move inside but not leave.

spell:ley-collapse.name: Ley Collapse
spell:ley-collapse.reason: The old art is a blue mind or face, not terrain breaking. Ley Collapse tears up the lines under a place and leaves the land wounded; the replacement shows a forceful arcane rupture.

spell:ley-rift.name: Ley Rift
spell:ley-rift.reason: A blue-green circular opening swirls around its center. Ley Rift cuts a seam in the world’s ley lines, matching the visible breach.

spell:ley-snare.name: Ley Snare
spell:ley-snare.reason: The old art is another city portal, not a restraint. Ley Snare ties a moving creature to a line; the replacement depicts a chain holding something in place.

spell:ley-storm.name: Ley Storm
spell:ley-storm.reason: The old art is a city inside a portal ring, which suggests travel. Ley Storm releases a held ley line inside a cage; the replacement depicts a celestial storm.

spell:ley-wound.name: Ley Wound
spell:ley-wound.reason: The old art is a city portal, implying travel. Ley Wound leaves a seam inside a creature; the replacement shows a concentrated arcane tear rather than a destination.

spell:light-unending.name: Light Unending
spell:light-unending.reason: Several figures stand beneath gold Light, fitting the group Ward, courage, and recurring healing.

spell:lightbrand.name: Lightbrand
spell:lightbrand.reason: A gold Holy weapon strike depicts a weapon carrying extra Light damage against undead and demons.

spell:lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
spell:lightning-bolt.reason: A blue bolt crosses the image. Lightning Bolt sends current where the caster points, matching the projectile.

spell:lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
spell:lightning-rod.reason: The old art is a gray tornado. Lightning Rod makes one creature attract electrical current; the replacement visibly depicts a lightning strike.

spell:lightning-shield.name: Lightning Shield
spell:lightning-shield.reason: A blue shield encircles the caster. Lightning Shield holds charges close enough to strike attackers, matching the protective electric shield.

spell:lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
spell:lightning-strike.reason: The old art is a dark sword with a wound on it. Lightning Strike calls down a column of current; the replacement visibly depicts lightning.

spell:lights-reach.name: Light's Reach
spell:lights-reach.reason: A golden figure reached by long rays of Light depicts healing delivered to a visible or remembered target.

spell:litany.name: Litany
spell:litany.reason: A gold silhouette stands within a ring of light. Litany gathers the Church’s words into a communal prayer, matching the robed figure and halo.

spell:living-flame.name: Living Flame
spell:living-flame.reason: A bright orange flame takes a humanoid shape, fitting the summoned Fire elemental.

spell:mana-burn.name: Mana Burn
spell:mana-burn.reason: The old art is a city portal. Mana Burn sets a creature’s stored magic alight; the replacement shows magic being drawn out of a figure.

spell:mana-lattice.name: Mana Lattice
spell:mana-lattice.reason: A blue arcane shield fits Ward against two named schools.

spell:mana-sear.name: Mana Sear
spell:mana-sear.reason: The old art is another city portal. Mana Sear sets the target’s stored power alight; the replacement shows magic being drawn out of a figure.

spell:mana-shield.name: Mana Shield
spell:mana-shield.reason: A blue magical shield fits harm redirected into the caster’s Mana pool.

spell:manafount.name: Manafount
spell:manafount.reason: The old art is a red portal flare, which does not read as a source. Manafount gives a pool an ongoing source; the replacement shows water pouring from a spring.

spell:manastorm.name: Manastorm
spell:manastorm.reason: The old art is a city portal. Manastorm releases raw power across the ground indiscriminately; the replacement depicts a storming field of magic.

spell:mark-of-the-wild.name: Mark of the Wild
spell:mark-of-the-wild.reason: The old art is a totem binding the earth, not a mark of nature. Mark of the Wild blesses a company with the wild’s protection; the replacement depicts living nature gathered around a figure.

spell:mass-dispel.name: Mass Dispel
spell:mass-dispel.reason: The old art is a purple clenched fist. Mass Dispel removes effects from everyone in an area; the replacement depicts a cleansing sweep.

spell:meteor.name: Meteor
spell:meteor.reason: A blazing rock falls through a dark sky. Meteor brings a burning mass down onto the ground, matching the falling projectile.

spell:mind-blast.name: Mind Blast
spell:mind-blast.reason: A hand presses into a face as if entering the mind. Mind Blast forces a thought into someone else’s mind, matching the invasive image.

spell:mind-flay.name: Mind Flay
spell:mind-flay.reason: A purple psychic eye and tendrils dominate the image. Mind Flay holds a connection while draining the target, matching the invasive mind effect.

spell:mind-sear.name: Mind Sear
spell:mind-sear.reason: A bright eye sits inside an expanding purple ring. Mind Sear attacks through focused mental force, matching the eye and radiating pressure.

spell:mind-soothe.name: Mind Soothe
spell:mind-soothe.reason: A lowered, shadowed face looks calm. Mind Soothe takes the edge off someone’s attention without controlling them, matching the softened expression.

spell:mind-vision.name: Mind Vision
spell:mind-vision.reason: A hooded figure peers from deep purple shadow. Mind Vision lets the priest see through another person’s eyes, matching the shadowed viewpoint.

spell:mindfetter.name: Mindfetter
spell:mindfetter.reason: The old art is a green and red burst. Mindfetter makes one direction difficult to think through; the replacement shows a guarded mind under shadow.

spell:mindlink.name: Mindlink
spell:mindlink.reason: The old art is a hand holding up a moon, which suggests an individual blessing. Mindlink lets six people share thoughts at once; the replacement depicts a concentrated psychic connection.

spell:mindstatic.name: Mindstatic
spell:mindstatic.reason: The mind themed shadow icon fits a localized disturbance of nearby thought and speech.

spell:mirror-image.name: Mirror Image
spell:mirror-image.reason: The old art is a green city portal, which suggests teleportation. Mirror Image creates three copies of the caster; the replacement visibly shows paired mirrored figures.

spell:moonfall.name: Moonfall
spell:moonfall.reason: The old art is a red portal ring, which implies travel. Moonfall brings moonlight down as weight; the replacement depicts light radiating from above.

spell:moonfire.name: Moonfire
spell:moonfire.reason: The old art is an orange city portal. Moonfire drops a column of moonlight that burns quietly; the replacement shows radiant moonlight rather than a place to travel.

spell:moonglow.name: Moonglow
spell:moonglow.reason: The old art is an orange city portal. Moonglow settles light onto a creature; the replacement shows a focused ray of luminous moonlight.

spell:moonpath.name: Moonpath
spell:moonpath.reason: A purple circular portal with a wild-place silhouette depicts travel beneath the night sky to a visited place.

spell:moonwell.name: Moonwell
spell:moonwell.reason: The old art is a city portal. Moonwell lends the water of a sacred well; the replacement visibly shows water pouring from a source.

spell:natures-cure.name: Nature's Cure
spell:natures-cure.reason: The old art is a rocky elemental, suggesting earth. Nature’s Cure removes a harmful effect; the replacement depicts cleansing and purging.

spell:natures-grasp.name: Nature's Grasp
spell:natures-grasp.reason: The old art is an impact in the ground. Nature’s Grasp waits with roots to seize anyone who approaches; the replacement shows a thorned plant that can catch a target.

spell:necrosis.name: Necrosis
spell:necrosis.reason: A face twisted in purple Shadow fits lingering necrotic pain that prevents healing and harms those who touch the target.

spell:necrotic-shell.name: Necrotic Shell
spell:necrotic-shell.reason: A green sigil forms an enclosing shell, fitting temporary Health built by Shadow or Fel damage.

spell:nether-collapse.name: Nether Collapse
spell:nether-collapse.reason: A green portal opens into darkness at ground level, fitting the area moved inside the Nether.

spell:nether-howl.name: Nether Howl
spell:nether-howl.reason: The old art is a cluster of bubbles. Nether Howl forces creatures to hear their own fear; the replacement depicts a scream spreading outward.

spell:nether-passage.name: Nether Passage
spell:nether-passage.reason: The old art is a demon’s face, not a passage. Nether Passage uses the thin boundary between places to cross through; the replacement shows an open portal.

spell:nether-rift.name: Nether Rift
spell:nether-rift.reason: Green light opens around a dark center. Nether Rift holds a seam open in the air, matching the visible opening.

spell:nether-ward.name: Nether Ward
spell:nether-ward.reason: A green armored shield depicts the quick Ward against Fel and Arcane.

spell:netherstorm.name: Netherstorm
spell:netherstorm.reason: The old proposal was an ice storm. Netherstorm releases fel energy across a field and leaves burning ground; the replacement shows green fel fire raining across an area.

spell:nightburn.name: Nightburn
spell:nightburn.reason: A pointed black shape cuts across purple shadow, fitting a lethal direct Shadow strike against wounded prey.

spell:nightfall.name: Nightfall
spell:nightfall.reason: A dark violet shroud sweeps across the icon, fitting an area where light cannot enter or leave.

spell:nightreach.name: Nightreach
spell:nightreach.reason: A purple figure reaches outward from the darkness. Nightreach projects shadow toward a distant creature, matching the extended reach.

spell:nullify.name: Nullify
spell:nullify.reason: A mouth sealed by a hand depicts the Silenced condition rather than disease removal.

spell:numbing-frost.name: Numbing Frost
spell:numbing-frost.reason: The old art is a dark blue whirlpool with no cold impact. Numbing Frost makes cold seize a target’s movement; the replacement depicts a sharp frost impact.

spell:pact-escrow.name: Pact Escrow
spell:pact-escrow.reason: The rune icon suits a stored, conditional magical payment governed by a pact.

spell:pain-suppression.name: Pain Suppression
spell:pain-suppression.reason: The old art is scattered purple sparks. Pain Suppression steps between a person and harm without healing them; the replacement visibly depicts an interposing shield.

spell:phantom-footsteps.name: Phantom Footsteps
spell:phantom-footsteps.reason: The shadow icon fits misleading phantom sounds that draw attention elsewhere.

spell:phoenix-courier.name: Phoenix Courier
spell:phoenix-courier.reason: The fire and speed icon suits a message borne quickly by a brief fiery projection.

spell:pilgrims-burden.name: Pilgrims' Burden
spell:pilgrims-burden.reason: The Holy aid icon fits the temporary redistribution of carried burden between willing travelers.

spell:portal.name: Portal
spell:portal.reason: A bright ring opens onto another place. Portal holds a door between two locations, matching the visible opening.

spell:power-word-fortitude.name: Power Word: Fortitude
spell:power-word-fortitude.reason: The old art is a lyre, suggesting music. Power Word: Fortitude increases a company’s maximum health; the replacement is a white-blue holy rune, suited to a spoken blessing that strengthens its recipients.

spell:power-word-shield.name: Power Word: Shield
spell:power-word-shield.reason: A bright shield fills the image. Power Word: Shield makes the world argue before reaching the target, matching direct protection.

spell:prayer-of-healing.name: Prayer of Healing
spell:prayer-of-healing.reason: The old art shows a mounted paladin, not a group receiving prayer. Prayer of Healing divides mercy among everyone who needs it; the replacement depicts a circle of shared healing.

spell:prayer-of-mending.name: Prayer of Mending
spell:prayer-of-mending.reason: The prayer and healing icon fits a blessing that answers later nonlethal harm.

spell:prayer-of-the-road.name: Prayer of the Road
spell:prayer-of-the-road.reason: An open hand glows with golden Light. Prayer of the Road blesses a company before travel, and the blessing hand fits the spoken protection.

spell:preservation.name: Preservation
spell:preservation.reason: A blue figure is held beside a time dial, fitting a target kept unchanged until release.

spell:prismatic-cascade.name: Prismatic Cascade
spell:prismatic-cascade.reason: The old art shows energy cascading out but no barrier. Prismatic Cascade distributes a brief protective shield across a group; the replacement visibly depicts a golden shield.

spell:prismatic-shield.name: Prismatic Shield
spell:prismatic-shield.reason: The old art is an orange portal swirl, not defense. Prismatic Shield sorts incoming effects by school; the replacement visibly shows a shield.

spell:psychic-scream.name: Psychic Scream
spell:psychic-scream.reason: A blue figure is ringed by a violent spiral. Psychic Scream drives terror outward from the priest, matching the person caught inside the scream’s wave.

spell:puppet.name: Puppet
spell:puppet.reason: A purple figure hangs beneath lines like a marionette. Puppet makes another body move at the caster’s direction, matching the controlled figure.

spell:purging-flame.name: Purging Flame
spell:purging-flame.reason: The old art is a blacksmith’s hammer, suggesting repair work. Purging Flame cauterizes a wound with fire; the replacement shows active flame.

spell:pyre.name: Pyre
spell:pyre.reason: An orange flame rises against black, fitting a Fire strike that leaves the ground burning.

spell:pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
spell:pyroclasm.reason: The old art is green fel flame, but Pyroclasm opens the ground and ejects Blackrock fire. The replacement shows a large erupting fireball.

spell:rain-of-chaos.name: Rain of Chaos
spell:rain-of-chaos.reason: Several green Fel meteors descend across the area, matching the Fel damage and burning ground.

spell:rain-of-fire.name: Rain of Fire
spell:rain-of-fire.reason: Several orange fiery streaks fall through darkness, depicting recurring Fire damage across the area.

spell:rainmaking.name: Rainmaking
spell:rainmaking.reason: Four colored elements meet in a central pattern. Rainmaking calls natural forces to bring rain, matching the elemental gathering.

spell:rebirth.name: Rebirth
spell:rebirth.reason: Blue and gold flames rise together from the center. Rebirth returns a dead creature to life, and the paired rising fires suggest renewed life.

spell:rebuke.name: Rebuke
spell:rebuke.reason: A clenched fist of golden light fills the image. Rebuke is a direct holy reprimand, and the raised fist conveys a forceful stop.

spell:rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
spell:rejuvenation.reason: Violet branches grow across the image. Rejuvenation sets growth into a person and lets it run, matching the growing form.

spell:rend-the-veil.name: Rend the Veil
spell:rend-the-veil.reason: A large staring eye fits seeing demons, souls, and open doors across the Nether boundary.

spell:renew.name: Renew
spell:renew.reason: A hand glows with soft green-white light. Renew sets healing to work gradually on a person, matching the continuing restorative glow.

spell:repentance.name: Repentance
spell:repentance.reason: A person kneels beneath descending Light. Repentance compels a target to acknowledge wrongdoing, matching the kneeling figure.

spell:restoration.name: Restoration
spell:restoration.reason: Green growth pushes out around a bright center, fitting blight cleared and dying plants recovering.

spell:return.name: Return
spell:return.reason: A gold spirit rising from a fallen body depicts the Light returning a dead creature to life.

spell:revelation.name: Revelation
spell:revelation.reason: The old art is a city portal. Revelation shows a company what is actually before them; the replacement sends a focused ray of insight.

spell:revival.name: Revival
spell:revival.reason: A pale blue spirit rises into a living form, fitting a dead creature returning at 1 Health.

spell:rewrite.name: Rewrite
spell:rewrite.reason: The old art is a monster screaming. Rewrite removes a memory from someone’s head; the replacement shows a hand reaching into a mind.

spell:rime-arrest.name: Rime Arrest
spell:rime-arrest.reason: The frost icon fits a brief arrest of an existing water flow by forming ice.

spell:rimebind.name: Rimebind
spell:rimebind.reason: The old art is a purple arcane orb. Rimebind holds a creature in place with cold; the replacement visibly shows icy chains around a target.

spell:rimeblood.name: Rimeblood
spell:rimeblood.reason: A purple-blue orb glows as if cold has settled inside it. Rimeblood carries frost through the target’s blood, matching the cold core.

spell:rimeburst.name: Rimeburst
spell:rimeburst.reason: The old art is two precise blue bolts. Rimeburst is an uncontrolled burst of cold across an area; the replacement shows a broad ice storm.

spell:rimeguard.name: Rimeguard
spell:rimeguard.reason: The old art is a volley of falling comets. Rimeguard spreads a thin ward over a group to absorb the first hit; the replacement shows protective ice arranged as a barrier.

spell:rimeshard.name: Rimeshard
spell:rimeshard.reason: The old art is a bowl of food. Rimeshard is heavy ice hurled at a target; the replacement shows a sharp shard of ice.

spell:ring-of-fire.name: Ring of Fire
spell:ring-of-fire.reason: An orange fire ring clearly depicts the Wall of Flame closing into a boundary.

spell:ritual-circle.name: Ritual Circle
spell:ritual-circle.reason: A glowing green ritual ring opens on the ground, fitting the circle that traps demons or elementals.

spell:rootbind.name: Rootbind
spell:rootbind.reason: The old art is a green shielded orb. Rootbind strengthens vines already holding a target; the replacement shows binding, thorned growth.

spell:ruination.name: Ruination
spell:ruination.reason: A green Fel impact spreads over the ground, fitting Fel damage and the burning patch left behind.

spell:salvation.name: Salvation
spell:salvation.reason: Several silhouettes stand beneath a bright orange-gold flare. Salvation protects a company through the Light, matching the group gathered under the radiance.

spell:sanctification.name: Sanctification
spell:sanctification.reason: A blue figure under descending gold Light evokes ground made holy against demons and undeath.

spell:sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
spell:sanctuary.reason: A shield centered in a blue aura depicts the protected area where harmful acts may fail.

spell:sanctum.name: Sanctum
spell:sanctum.reason: The old art is a city portal, which implies a route outward. Sanctum folds a room inward and stops others from reaching it; the replacement depicts a protective barrier.

spell:scentweave.name: Scentweave
spell:scentweave.reason: The Nature icon fits the shaping of a sampled scent into a temporary trail.

spell:scorch.name: Scorch
spell:scorch.reason: A compact orange firebolt fits the direct Fire damage against one target.

spell:scorched-earth.name: Scorched Earth
spell:scorched-earth.reason: Orange fire crawls over cracked ground. Scorched Earth burns the terrain itself, matching the fiery land.

spell:scour.name: Scour
spell:scour.reason: The old art is a brown shield. Scour burns everything across an area like a surgeon cauterizing a field; the replacement shows active flame.

spell:sealing-flame.name: Sealing Flame
spell:sealing-flame.reason: An orange fire-edged shield depicts the life-saving Fire effect that closes wounds at 0 Health.

spell:searing-pain.name: Searing Pain
spell:searing-pain.reason: An orange burning face depicts Fire damage that leaves the target struggling to attack.

spell:seedwake.name: Seedwake
spell:seedwake.reason: The growth and renewal icon fits accelerated germination of viable seeds.

spell:sending.name: Sending
spell:sending.reason: The old art is a city portal, which implies physical travel. Sending places a sentence directly in someone’s mind; the replacement shows a focused psychic beam.

spell:shadow-bolt.name: Shadow Bolt
spell:shadow-bolt.reason: Purple-green energy flies from the center. Shadow Bolt is a directed shadow projectile, matching the bolt in flight.

spell:shadow-walk.name: Shadow Walk
spell:shadow-walk.reason: The old art is two orange projectiles in flight. Shadow Walk steps into shadow and emerges elsewhere; the replacement depicts a rapid spatial shift.

spell:shadow-ward.name: Shadow Ward
spell:shadow-ward.reason: A jagged violet shield emblem depicts Ward against Shadow.

spell:shadow-wave.name: Shadow Wave
spell:shadow-wave.reason: A grey-black wave curls into a broad cone, fitting Shadow damage and possible Blinded condition.

spell:shadow-word-anguish.name: Shadow Word: Anguish
spell:shadow-word-anguish.reason: A face contorted in purple shadow fits escalating pain on a target already under Shadow Word: Pain.

spell:shadow-word-hunger.name: Shadow Word: Hunger
spell:shadow-word-hunger.reason: A green spectral hand reaches outward, fitting ongoing Shadow damage that feeds the caster Health.

spell:shadow-word-pain.name: Shadow Word: Pain
spell:shadow-word-pain.reason: A skull burns with red pain. Shadow Word: Pain keeps pain on a target, matching the icon’s suffering.

spell:shadowmend.name: Shadowmend
spell:shadowmend.reason: A purple sigil closes around a woundlike center. Shadowmend mends with shadow magic, matching the restorative arcane pattern.

spell:shadowveil.name: Shadowveil
spell:shadowveil.reason: A hooded figure in purple shadow fits concealment and a protective Shadow veil.

spell:signal-fire.name: Signal Fire
spell:signal-fire.reason: A small orange flame burns alone against a dark field. Signal Fire is a fire set to call others’ attention, matching the visible beacon.

spell:siphon-life.name: Siphon Life
spell:siphon-life.reason: The old art is a green weapon, suggesting a strike. Siphon Life opens a line that drains a target into the caster; the replacement visibly depicts life being drawn away.

spell:skyfall.name: Skyfall
spell:skyfall.reason: The old art is a city inside a portal. Skyfall releases the stored star pattern so its contents come down at once; the replacement visibly shows stars falling.

spell:slagfall.name: Slagfall
spell:slagfall.reason: Orange molten streaks fall across dark ground, matching recurring Fire damage on scorched terrain.

spell:slow.name: Slow
spell:slow.reason: An orange chain-like curl visibly arrests motion, fitting Slowed and loss of a Reaction.

spell:slow-fall.name: Slow Fall
spell:slow-fall.reason: The old art is a violet rune, not a falling body. Slow Fall reduces the speed of a descent; the replacement visibly shows a feather and conveys a gentle fall.

spell:smite.name: Smite
spell:smite.reason: The old art is a moonlit landscape. Smite is a Light attack brought down on a target; the replacement shows a sharp golden beam of holy light.

spell:smolder.name: Smolder
spell:smolder.reason: Glowing embers trail away from a hot center. Smolder is fire kept alive at a low heat, matching the lingering coals.

spell:soul-ledger.name: Soul Ledger
spell:soul-ledger.reason: The old art is a green creature or spirit. Soul Ledger records bargains made with souls; the replacement is visibly a book.

spell:soul-link.name: Soul Link
spell:soul-link.reason: A violet chain joins two figures. Soul Link shares harm between its two participants, matching the visible connection.

spell:soul-reaper.name: Soul Reaper
spell:soul-reaper.reason: The old art is a green ghostlike eye. Soul Reaper catches a soul as its target nears death; the replacement depicts a soul contained in a dark gem.

spell:soulburn.name: Soulburn
spell:soulburn.reason: A purple skull inside violet flame evokes burning a drained soul for Fel damage and Mana.

spell:soulchains.name: Soulchains
spell:soulchains.reason: The old art is a plague skull. Soulchains link the warlock and a demon by an actual chain; the replacement visibly depicts binding chains.

spell:soulfire.name: Soulfire
spell:soulfire.reason: An orange fireball surges forward. Soulfire launches destructive flame, matching the visible projectile.

spell:soulshield.name: Soulshield
spell:soulshield.reason: An enclosing green sigil depicts Ward and temporary Health built around the caster.

spell:soulstone.name: Soulstone
spell:soulstone.reason: The old art is an eyeball, which suggests sight. Soulstone preserves a soul for return; the replacement depicts a contained soul gem.

spell:soulwell.name: Soulwell
spell:soulwell.reason: A dark purple soul gem depicts the stones the well offers to allies for healing.

spell:speak-with-the-dead.name: Speak with the Dead
spell:speak-with-the-dead.reason: Several pale ghostly skulls depict a corpse giving voice to the dead person’s memories.

spell:spell-relay.name: Spell Relay
spell:spell-relay.reason: The arcane icon fits the transfer of a willing caster's already prepared spell.

spell:spellwrights-mark.name: Spellwright's Mark
spell:spellwrights-mark.reason: The arcane craft icon suits a temporary written mark that stores a prepared spell.

spell:spirit-of-redemption.name: Spirit of Redemption
spell:spirit-of-redemption.reason: A red-gold spirit rises above a fallen body. Spirit of Redemption is the Light’s final presence after death, matching the departing spirit.

spell:splinter.name: Splinter
spell:splinter.reason: The old art is a plate of food. Splinter is a nonmagical shard hurled at a target; the replacement depicts several sharp ice-like splinters.

spell:starbind.name: Starbind
spell:starbind.reason: Blue-white star projectiles depict the Arcane strike that consumes Moonfire and may pass it on.

spell:starfall.name: Starfall
spell:starfall.reason: Blue-white stars streak down from above. Starfall drops a star that carries its force over an area, matching the falling lights.

spell:starfire.name: Starfire
spell:starfire.reason: Two bright blue stars shoot across the icon. Starfire calls down a star that burns for several turns, matching the celestial projectile.

spell:starsurge.name: Starsurge
spell:starsurge.reason: The old art is a city portal, unrelated to a star attack. Starsurge is a druidic celestial strike; the replacement shows a star streaking into the target.

spell:starweave.name: Starweave
spell:starweave.reason: The old art is a green city portal. Starweave holds the pattern of stars until they are released as Skyfall; the replacement depicts bright star bolts.

spell:stasis.name: Stasis
spell:stasis.reason: The old art is a Dalaran city portal, which implies travel. Stasis holds named creatures outside ordinary time; the replacement is an orange-rimmed clock, directly signaling temporal suspension.

spell:stay-the-hand.name: Stay the Hand
spell:stay-the-hand.reason: A raised hand before warm Light depicts saving a target from dropping to 0 Health.

spell:stillfrost.name: Stillfrost
spell:stillfrost.reason: An icy blue face enclosed in frost evokes a living target preserved outside time.

spell:stone-spike.name: Stone Spike
spell:stone-spike.reason: The old art is a helmet, and the previous proposal was an ice spike. Stone Spike drives earth up through a standing target; the replacement shows jagged brown earth peaks erupting from the ground.

spell:stormfury.name: Stormfury
spell:stormfury.reason: A dark eye sits inside a circular storm. Stormfury gathers the storm’s attention and force, matching the centered eye of the tempest.

spell:stormwall.name: Stormwall
spell:stormwall.reason: A shield edged in blue lightning fits a wall that blocks ranged attacks and shocks passage.

spell:summoners-writ.name: Summoner's Writ
spell:summoners-writ.reason: The demonic pact icon fits a temporary grant of command permission over a bound demon.

spell:sundering.name: Sundering
spell:sundering.reason: The old art is a focused mind. Sundering asks the ground to stop being one piece; the replacement depicts an earthquake splitting earth.

spell:sunfire.name: Sunfire
spell:sunfire.reason: A white-hot orange sunburst depicts overwhelming Fire damage across a broad area.

spell:tempest.name: Tempest
spell:tempest.reason: Grey streaks sweep across green air, fitting a moving cyclone that damages and pushes creatures.

spell:the-black-harvest.name: The Black Harvest
spell:the-black-harvest.reason: A dark purple hand grips upward, fitting ability taken permanently from another creature.

spell:the-burning.name: The Burning
spell:the-burning.reason: A bright orange explosion flares out from a dark center. The Burning releases destructive fire, matching the expanding blast.

spell:the-deep.name: The Deep
spell:the-deep.reason: A dark violet shroud fits an area without light or sound where creatures are Blinded and Deafened.

spell:the-fifth-light.name: The Fifth Light
spell:the-fifth-light.reason: The old art is a skull, suggesting exorcism. The Fifth Light calls the Church’s virtues together as a force; the replacement shows overwhelming holy radiance.

spell:the-great-wild.name: The Great Wild
spell:the-great-wild.reason: The old art is a blue glyph with no wild life in it. The Great Wild opens the caster to ancient nature; the replacement shows living branches.

spell:the-last-word.name: The Last Word
spell:the-last-word.reason: The old art is a yellow flame, which suggests fire magic. The Last Word is a Light judgment spoken at the end of a fight; the replacement shows a hand issuing a command.

spell:the-long-bargain.name: The Long Bargain
spell:the-long-bargain.reason: A green demonic figure extends a hand, fitting a Legion bargain that grants a request and demands a price.

spell:the-long-winter.name: The Long Winter
spell:the-long-winter.reason: A blue snowflake fills the icon. The Long Winter lays sustained cold over an area, matching the winter mark.

spell:the-whisper.name: The Whisper
spell:the-whisper.reason: A dark violet rune depicts the forbidden knowledge gained from a truthful supernatural answer.

spell:thornguard.name: Thornguard
spell:thornguard.reason: A woody arch bristling with thorns depicts the growth that Entangles and hurts intruders.

spell:thorns.name: Thorns
spell:thorns.reason: A bare branch bristles with sharp thorns. Thorns deals with thorn growth, and the image depicts the plant directly.

spell:thoughtsteal.name: Thoughtsteal
spell:thoughtsteal.reason: The old art is a static blue seal. Thoughtsteal takes a thought directly from another mind; the replacement shows a hand reaching into a face and makes the intrusion legible.

spell:thunderhead.name: Thunderhead
spell:thunderhead.reason: Blue lightning branches across a storm sky, fitting the moving field that shocks one creature each turn.

spell:tidebreath.name: Tidebreath
spell:tidebreath.reason: The Shaman water icon fits speech carried between creatures underwater.

spell:tidecall.name: Tidecall
spell:tidecall.reason: The old art is a carved orange face. Tidecall asks a water spirit to stay; the replacement visibly shows water pouring from a summoned source.

spell:tranquility.name: Tranquility
spell:tranquility.reason: Soft rain crosses a dim landscape, fitting group healing that renews each Rejuvenation.

spell:translocate.name: Translocate
spell:translocate.reason: A bright violet portal ring opens around the center. Translocate moves a creature between positions, matching the doorway.

spell:tree-of-life.name: Tree of Life
spell:tree-of-life.reason: A luminous green leaf curls across the frame. Tree of Life is a druidic life form, matching the living plant motif.

spell:turn-undead.name: Turn Undead
spell:turn-undead.reason: A green undead face fills the icon. Turn Undead affects the undead directly, matching the subject.

spell:umbra.name: Umbra
spell:umbra.reason: A shadowed face and reaching hand emerge from purple light. Umbra draws on a person’s shadow, matching the dark projection.

spell:unmaking.name: Unmaking
spell:unmaking.reason: A blue beam cuts through a figure. Unmaking pulls apart what the Nether has made, matching the destructive arcane ray.

spell:unweave.name: Unweave
spell:unweave.reason: The old art is a Dalaran city portal, implying transport. Unweave pulls apart the magic holding a target together; the replacement shows arcane energy unraveling and dispersing.

spell:verdance.name: Verdance
spell:verdance.reason: A bright green leaf glows against dark green. Verdance restores vitality and movement; the growing leaf fits renewal.

spell:verdict.name: Verdict
spell:verdict.reason: A blade of Light is driven down into the scene. Verdict judges a target after a proceeding, matching the decisive strike.

spell:vigil.name: Vigil
spell:vigil.reason: A golden figure stands inside a radiant ward. Vigil asks the Light to keep watch, matching the guarded figure.

spell:void-eruption.name: Void Eruption
spell:void-eruption.reason: A green-violet rift bursts open. Void Eruption releases a mass of Void energy, matching the rupture.

spell:void-rift.name: Void Rift
spell:void-rift.reason: A purple opening breaks into the dark. Void Rift opens a breach into the Void, matching the visible tear.

spell:void-tide.name: Void Tide
spell:void-tide.reason: A purple wave carries dark, skull-like forms. Void Tide sends the Void across an area, matching the advancing shadow wave.

spell:wall-of-flame.name: Wall of Flame
spell:wall-of-flame.reason: The old art is a smith’s hammer. Wall of Flame stands in a line and burns whoever crosses; the replacement shows active flame.

spell:wall-of-ice.name: Wall of Ice
spell:wall-of-ice.reason: The old art is a small cyan rune. Wall of Ice creates a physical barrier across the ground; the replacement visibly depicts a wall of ice.

spell:wasting.name: Wasting
spell:wasting.reason: Purple diseased faces fit the ongoing Shadow wasting that lowers maximum Health.

spell:watchfire.name: Watchfire
spell:watchfire.reason: The old art is a flaming hammer, which implies a weapon attack. Watchfire is a small suspended fire that watches a pass; the replacement shows a bright flare held aloft as a signal.

spell:water-walking.name: Water Walking
spell:water-walking.reason: The old art shows a hand producing healing water. Water Walking lets a person move across the surface; the replacement depicts feet moving over water.

spell:watershed.name: Watershed
spell:watershed.reason: The water and Nature icon fits a divination about the direction and condition of nearby water.

spell:wellspring.name: Wellspring
spell:wellspring.reason: Green water curls from an open hand. Wellspring finds someone who needs healing and keeps the help running, matching the restorative water.

spell:whiteout.name: Whiteout
spell:whiteout.reason: The old art is a purple shadow. Whiteout turns the sky into an opaque white storm; the replacement shows swirling arctic wind and snow.

spell:wildfire.name: Wildfire
spell:wildfire.reason: The old art is blue falling projectiles. Wildfire is fire spreading across an area; the replacement shows a broad orange flame rather than aimed shots.
