spell:windrush.name: Windrush
spell:windrush.reason: The old art is a gray hammer and does not show air or travel. Windrush moves an entire company swiftly through the passes; the replacement depicts a strong stream of wind.

spell:windshear.name: Windshear
spell:windshear.reason: The old art is an animal face shouting. Windshear cuts the air with a forceful gust; the replacement depicts a stream of wind.

spell:windwalk.name: Windwalk
spell:windwalk.reason: Green motion streaks depict the fast crossing of ground and obstacles.

spell:winterborn.name: Winterborn
spell:winterborn.reason: An ice-encrusted face depicts a body made immune to Frost and dangerous to nearby creatures.

spell:winterheart.name: Winterheart
spell:winterheart.reason: A blue circular core glows inside frost. Winterheart gathers cold into one target, matching the frozen core.

spell:winters-chill.name: Winter's Chill
spell:winters-chill.reason: The old art is a bright green orb. Winter’s Chill strips away cold tolerance; the replacement shows a cold burst against a target.

spell:winters-grip.name: Winter's Grip
spell:winters-grip.reason: A circular blue frost pattern depicts water across the area freezing hard and trapping swimmers.

spell:winterskin.name: Winterskin
spell:winterskin.reason: A blue crystalline shield depicts Ward against Fire and Frost around the caster.

spell:wrath.name: Wrath
spell:wrath.reason: The old art is a swarm of insects, but Wrath calls elemental wind and thrown growth. The replacement shows a storm being called.

talent:absolute-zero.name: Absolute Zero
talent:absolute-zero.reason: Align with the named Absolute Zero spell: The art is a blue spiral of icy wind. Absolute Zero describes cold so complete it becomes its absence; the frozen vortex communicates the spell’s subject.

talent:absorption.name: Absorption
talent:absorption.reason: Replace: Absolution is a closed book, not a protective image. The inspected shield and halo depict the Ward trigger that absorbs all damage and converts it to Mana.

talent:adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
talent:adrenaline.reason: Retain: the orange rogue ambush art fits this rogue resource talent; its quick-action look supports the Energy and Combo Point cycle.

talent:aegis-eternal.name: Aegis Eternal
talent:aegis-eternal.reason: Replace: Arcane Intellect is an abstract blue arcane knot, not protection. The inspected Power Word: Shield image is a clear shield, matching universal Ward that cannot be removed.

talent:aegis-of-the-light.name: Aegis of the Light
talent:aegis-of-the-light.reason: Align with the named Aegis of the Light spell: The old art is a blue arcane knot, not a protective shape. The spell lays the Light between a whole company and incoming harm; the replacement visibly depicts a shield held in front of its bearer.

talent:afterimage.name: Afterimage
talent:afterimage.reason: Retain: the mirror image is exactly the defensive feint described by this reaction, which makes a hit miss.

talent:aimed-volley.name: Aimed Volley
talent:aimed-volley.reason: Retain: the drawn bow and arrow directly match the ranged attack result that returns Focus.

talent:ancestors-hand.name: Ancestor's Hand
talent:ancestors-hand.reason: Retain: the shamanic heroism image fits the ancestral rescue theme and the effect that restores Dying allies.

talent:ancestral-ear.name: Ancestral Ear
talent:ancestral-ear.reason: A luminous humanlike spirit represents hearing the dead at a place.

talent:ancestral-guidance.name: Ancestral Guidance
talent:ancestral-guidance.reason: Retain: the ancestral spirit art supports the talent’s copied healing trigger and nearby secondary recipient.

talent:ancestral-knowledge.name: Ancestral Knowledge
talent:ancestral-knowledge.reason: Retain: the nature-dispel artwork suits this magic reliability talent, which prevents a failed Casting Test from consuming Mana.

talent:ancestral-spirit.name: Ancestral Spirit
talent:ancestral-spirit.reason: Retain: the multi-totem spirit image reads as a group return from death, matching the long-rest resurrection effect.

talent:ancestral-tide.name: Ancestral Tide
talent:ancestral-tide.reason: Align with the named Ancestral Tide spell: The old art is a green magical burst, with no ancestral presence. Ancestral Tide calls the shamans who came before; the replacement shows an ancestral, totemlike spirit emblem.

talent:anchor.name: Anchor
talent:anchor.reason: Replace: The proposed art is a shouting warrior; it does not show an enemy being held in place. The purple web visibly binds, matching enemies who cannot Disengage.

talent:anticipation.name: Anticipation
talent:anticipation.reason: Replace: Blackjack shows a club, not a defense. The crossed blades depict the ranged Parry this talent grants.

talent:apothecarys-hand.name: Apothecary's Hand
talent:apothecarys-hand.reason: A sickly green face evokes the poisons and plagues the apothecary understands.

talent:arcane-concentration.name: Arcane Concentration
talent:arcane-concentration.reason: Retain: the blue arcane orb signals spell focus; the mechanic reduces the Mana cost of sustaining spells.

talent:arcane-missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
talent:arcane-missiles.reason: Align with the named Arcane Missiles spell: The old icon is a literal blue shield, which reads as defense. The spell launches repeated arcane bolts; the inspected Starfall artwork shows a volley of bright falling projectiles and communicates that action.

talent:arcane-power.name: Arcane Power
talent:arcane-power.reason: Retain: the bright arcane orb depicts a short-lived spell damage surge, the exact effect granted here.

talent:archmage.name: Archmage
talent:archmage.reason: Align with the named Archmage spell: A robed mage silhouette stands above a group. Archmage names a caster’s attained mastery, and the image clearly identifies a powerful mage.

talent:arclight-spanner.name: Arclight Spanner
talent:arclight-spanner.reason: Retain: the image is a large engineering spanner, matching the tool used to repair constructs, armor, weapons, and locks.

talent:ardent-defender.name: Ardent Defender
talent:ardent-defender.reason: Retain: the golden armored defender art aligns with the named defensive class feature and its reduced Zeal cost.

talent:ascendance.name: Ascendance
talent:ascendance.reason: Retain: the ascending shaman figure matches the talent’s brief elevation of Fire and Nature spell results.

talent:assembly-line.name: Assembly Line
talent:assembly-line.reason: Replace: Distract shows a purple distraction swirl. The gear and wrench artwork depicts building and holding multiple constructs.

talent:atonement.name: Atonement
talent:atonement.reason: Retain: the priestly healing emblem fits the Ward-to-restoration link at the center of this talent.

talent:avenging-bulwark.name: Avenging Bulwark
talent:avenging-bulwark.reason: Replace: the assigned aspiration burst suggests a generic blessing. The shield wall image makes the talent’s shield-carried protection and shared Armor Points legible.

talent:axe-and-hammer.name: Axe and Hammer
talent:axe-and-hammer.reason: Replace: Intensify Rage depicts a red armored figure, not two weapons. The inspected art shows a blade in each hand, matching the axe-and-hammer requirement.

talent:backdraft.name: Backdraft
talent:backdraft.reason: Retain: the fiery warlock image supports the casting surge that makes the next spell faster.

talent:bad-mojo.name: Bad Mojo
talent:bad-mojo.reason: Retain: the repulsion totem art supports the control effect that stuns a failed target.

talent:banshees-wail.name: Banshee's Wail

talent:bestial-wrath.name: Bestial Wrath

talent:blood-sport.name: Blood Sport

talent:bloodied-blade.reason: Retain: the spinning bloodied blade corresponds to the two-handed critical-injury trigger.

talent:bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst

talent:bones-and-feathers.name: Bones and Feathers
talent:bones-and-feathers.reason: The bone-and-feather doll fits omens and folk wards.

talent:bracing.name: Bracing

talent:burial-ground.name: Burial Ground
talent:burial-ground.reason: Retain: the Stone Bulwark totem icon matches the protective ward laid over the selected patch of ground.

talent:burning-soul.reason: Retain: the burning soul icon directly depicts the Fire spells whose immunity is reduced to Ward.

talent:call-of-flame.name: Call of Flame
talent:call-of-flame.reason: Retain: the flaming weapon icon matches the Searing totem’s increased Fire damage.

talent:camouflage.name: Camouflage
talent:camouflage.reason: Retain: the hunter camouflage image depicts concealment in natural terrain, including while moving.

talent:camp-born.name: Camp-Born
talent:camp-born.reason: A probing eye fits reading guards and finding an escape.

talent:cannibalize.name: Cannibalize
talent:cannibalize.reason: A red life-draining glow fits feeding on a corpse to regain Health.

talent:careful-shot.name: Careful Shot
talent:careful-shot.reason: Replace: Iron Hawk depicts a bird. The aimed bow image communicates a deliberate shot that ignores engagement and cover penalties.

talent:cartel-contact.name: Cartel Contact
talent:cartel-contact.reason: The gold coin marks a costly trade contact in any port.

talent:cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
talent:cataclysm.reason: Align with the named Cataclysm spell: The art shows a fiery break in the land. Cataclysm is the destructive spell that broke Draenor, so the scorched terrain conveys its scale.

talent:cauterize.name: Cauterize
talent:cauterize.reason: Retain: the blue flame depicts the fire that prevents death and burns nearby enemies.

talent:celestial-alignment.name: Celestial Alignment

talent:chastise.name: Chastise
talent:chastise.reason: Retain: the holy restraint image matches the effect that makes Holy damage penetrate Ward.

talent:cheap-shot.name: Cheap Shot

talent:chimaera-shot.name: Chimaera Shot
talent:chimaera-shot.reason: Replace: the assigned Aimed Shot art depicts one bow projectile. The inspected Chimaera Shot image shows a branching multi-colored shot, matching the wider multi-target Barrage.

talent:chimera.name: Chimera
talent:chimera.reason: Retain: the chimera creature directly matches merging two Shapeshift forms into one hybrid form.

talent:circle-of-healing.name: Circle of Healing
talent:circle-of-healing.reason: Retain: the radiant holy circle depicts the additional nearby recipient of Mend.

talent:cleanse.name: Cleanse

talent:clearcasting.reason: Retain: the bright arcane flare depicts a successful overchannel returning Mana.

talent:cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
talent:cloak-of-shadows.reason: Replace: Bloody Eye depicts an eye. The violet cloak silhouette directly represents temporary school protection under a cloak.

talent:cloudburst.name: Cloudburst
talent:cloudburst.reason: Replace: The proposed purple spiral reads as arcane travel, not a healing burst. A blue water vortex conveys one healing spell spreading to nearby allies.

talent:cluster-rockets.name: Cluster Rockets
talent:cluster-rockets.reason: Replace: Dual Wield shows crossed swords. The red bomb and blast art represents a construct firing clustered explosives at an area.

talent:coated-blades.name: Coated Blades
talent:coated-blades.reason: Replace: the assigned Aspect of the Viper art is a purple eye, not a poison blade. The inspected Deadly Brew art shows poison-coated weapons and matches applying poison during an attack.

talent:cold-company.name: Cold Company
talent:cold-company.reason: Replace: Critical Shot depicts an aimed attack. The skull and raised dead image fits speaking with the recently dead and resisting fear.

talent:combat-reflexes.name: Combat Reflexes
talent:combat-reflexes.reason: Replace: Cannonball Barrage depicts an explosive projectile. Crossed blades depict the additional Reaction usable for Parry.

talent:combustion.name: Combustion
talent:combustion.reason: Retain: the blue fire burst matches the damage bonus against an already burning target.

talent:command-demon.name: Command Demon
talent:command-demon.reason: Replace: Animatedead depicts a risen corpse. The demonic figure in Demonic Empowerment matches binding a living demon.

talent:common-tongue.name: Common Tongue
talent:common-tongue.reason: A speaking figure depicts making oneself understood across a language barrier.

talent:concussive-shot.name: Concussive Shot
talent:concussive-shot.reason: Replace: Assassinate depicts a lethal close strike. The bow and aimed arrow identify this as a ranged shot that slows its target.

talent:cone-of-cold.name: Cone of Cold
talent:cone-of-cold.reason: Replace: Chains of Ice depicts a binding effect. The frost burst depicts a cone of cold damage rather than restraint.

talent:conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
talent:conflagrate.reason: Align with the named spell: an orange target engulfed in flame depicts the Immolate burn consumed for stronger damage.

talent:consecrated-ground.name: Consecrated Ground
talent:consecrated-ground.reason: Replace: the assigned Blessed Recovery art is a kneeling figure. The inspected Holy Nova burst depicts holy power spreading over the ground this Consecration modifies.

talent:counterstrike.name: Counterstrike
talent:counterstrike.reason: Replace: The proposed dark footstep art does not depict a retaliatory attack. The crossing blades depict the Riposte whose damage this talent raises.

talent:critical-strike.name: Critical Strike
talent:critical-strike.reason: Retain: the crossed weapon image reads as a decisive critical hit, matching the attack’s extra damage.

talent:crusader-strike.name: Crusader Strike
talent:crusader-strike.reason: Retain: the bright holy strike depicts the attack empowered by spending Zeal.

talent:curse-of-agony.name: Curse of Agony

talent:cursed-prey.name: Cursed Prey
talent:cursed-prey.reason: Replace: The proposed art shows a green totem activation, while the talent exploits a condition laid on prey. A purple curse-grip visually marks a conditioned victim that the hunter attacks with a Boon.

talent:da-voodoo.name: Da Voodoo
talent:da-voodoo.reason: The green frog's face depicts a hex, matching the curse that puts a Bane on a creature.

talent:dark-minion.name: Dark Minion
talent:dark-minion.reason: Replace: Crossfire depicts arrows. The skull and raised dead image matches a target rising as a Risen Skeleton.

talent:deadeye.name: Deadeye
talent:deadeye.reason: Retain: the Deadeye image directly depicts a target in a sight, matching the expanded critical-injury range.

talent:deadly-poise.name: Deadly Poise
talent:deadly-poise.reason: Retain: the rogue combat-expertise image shows a poised blade, matching the single-opponent attack bonus.

talent:death-mark.name: Death Mark
talent:death-mark.reason: Retain: the marked-target combat symbol fits a named mark whose target is tracked until it dies.

talent:deep-cut.name: Deep Cut
talent:deep-cut.reason: Retain: the blood nova depicts the Bleeding condition this attack applies.

talent:deep-freeze.name: Deep Freeze
talent:deep-freeze.reason: Retain: the ice prison image matches the second failed Frost Nova test that stuns the target.

talent:deep-roads.name: Deep Roads
talent:deep-roads.reason: Carved stone marks the worked underground passages the dwarf can navigate.

talent:deflection.name: Deflection
talent:deflection.reason: Replace: the assigned Bloodlust artwork depicts aggression. Crossed blades explicitly depict the Parry and Block defenses this talent improves.

talent:deft-hands.name: Deft Hands
talent:deft-hands.reason: Replace: Combat Readiness depicts a combat stance. The poison vial image matches applying a carried poison during an attack.

talent:demonic-aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
talent:demonic-aegis.reason: Retain: the anti-shadow shield depicts Armor and Ward protection granted to the demon.

talent:demonic-ascendance.name: Demonic Ascendance

talent:demonic-embrace.name: Demonic Embrace

talent:demonic-empowerment.name: Demonic Empowerment
talent:demonic-empowerment.reason: Retain: the demon empowerment artwork is the named effect and depicts the demon’s stronger attacks.

talent:doom-winds.name: Doom Winds

talent:drain-soul.name: Drain Soul

talent:drawn-across.name: Drawn Across

talent:earthen-shield.name: Earthen Shield

talent:earthmothers-portion.name: Earthmother's Portion
talent:earthmothers-portion.reason: Fresh water from nature fits finding food and water for the party.

talent:elders-standing.name: Elder's Standing

talent:elunes-light.reason: Moonlit radiance depicts the visible light under night sky.

talent:elunes-regard.reason: The lunar blessing fits an unlikely failure turned to success by Elune.

talent:elusive.name: Elusive

talent:emberstorm.name: Emberstorm
talent:emberstorm.reason: Retain: the blue flame bolt depicts the Fire and Fel spells whose Mana cost is reduced.

talent:enrage.reason: Retain: the druid rage flare matches gaining Rage when a hit reaches Health.

talent:entrapment.name: Entrapment
talent:entrapment.reason: Retain: the barbed shot image depicts a snare that wounds a creature pulling free.

talent:envenom.name: Envenom

talent:escape-artist.name: Escape Artist
talent:escape-artist.reason: A hook and rope evoke wriggling out of a bind or grapple.

talent:ethereal-form.name: Ethereal Form
talent:ethereal-form.reason: Replace: Tranquil Mind Totem depicts a totem. The shadow cloak silhouette conveys becoming ethereal and halving physical damage.

talent:everlasting-affliction.name: Everlasting Affliction
talent:everlasting-affliction.reason: Retain: the warlock affliction image directly depicts ongoing effects lasting longer.

talent:evil-eye.name: Evil Eye

talent:executioner.name: Executioner

talent:explorers-league.name: Explorers' League
talent:explorers-league.reason: An engraved stone tablet fits reading ancient inscriptions and Titan ruins.

talent:fan-of-knives.name: Fan of Knives
talent:fan-of-knives.reason: Retain: the fan of knives image directly matches the multi-target knife attack.

talent:fanaticism.name: Fanaticism
talent:fanaticism.reason: Retain: the fanaticism image depicts Zeal and matches preserving and beginning combat with it.

talent:farstriders-eye.name: Farstrider's Eye
talent:farstriders-eye.reason: The sharp eagle gaze marks exceptional long-range sight.

talent:feign-death.name: Feign Death
talent:feign-death.reason: Retain: the deathly red figure matches the talent’s deliberate false-death state.

talent:feint.name: Feint

talent:fel-domination.name: Fel Domination
talent:fel-domination.reason: Retain: the domination rune image matches the Fel power that makes demon summoning faster and cheaper.

talent:fel-fire.name: Fel Fire
talent:fel-fire.reason: Retain: the green Fel fire image directly depicts converting Fire spells to Fel damage.

talent:felguard.name: Felguard
talent:felguard.reason: Retain: the dark burning spirit image depicts the axe-bearing Felguard demon this talent summons.

talent:feral-charge.name: Feral Charge
talent:feral-charge.reason: Retain: the warrior charge image depicts the rapid movement attached to a Shapeshift attack.

talent:feral-instinct.name: Feral Instinct
talent:feral-instinct.reason: Replace: Aquatic Form depicts swimming. The cat form identifies the Shapeshift attacks whose flank damage this talent raises.

talent:feral-spirit.name: Feral Spirit
talent:feral-spirit.reason: Retain: the image depicts two spirit wolves, matching the pair summoned by this talent.

talent:ferocious-bite.name: Ferocious Bite
talent:ferocious-bite.reason: Retain: the beast-call icon depicts a companion biting a target and causing Bleeding.

talent:find-weakness.name: Find Weakness
talent:find-weakness.reason: Retain: the Find Weakness mark depicts exploiting armor while attacking from hiding.

talent:fireball.reason: Align with the named Fireball spell: A bright orange fireball leaves the center of the icon. Fireball throws a mote of flame that bursts on impact; the image depicts that action.

talent:firestorm.name: Firestorm
talent:firestorm.reason: Retain: the blue flame spell art depicts the area fire effect this talent modifies.

talent:flametongue.name: Flametongue
talent:flametongue.reason: Replace: Echo of the Elements depicts an elemental swirl. The flaming weapon image directly matches weapon attacks becoming Fire damage.

talent:fleet-footed.name: Fleet Footed
talent:fleet-footed.reason: Retain: the fleet-footed icon depicts a runner, matching movement that raises Defense.

talent:flurry.name: Flurry
talent:flurry.reason: Replace: The proposed crossed-sword challenge icon depicts a duel, not rapid extra attacks. Several streaking blades depict the extra attacks earned on high success.

talent:follow-through.name: Follow Through
talent:follow-through.reason: Retain: the cleaving weapon image matches an attack that follows a takedown.

talent:force-of-nature.name: Force of Nature
talent:force-of-nature.reason: Retain: the spell image depicts treants emerging from the ground, matching the summoned creatures.

talent:foresight.name: Foresight
talent:foresight.reason: Replace: The proposed fiery face is unrelated to reacting after a hit or known damage. A blue timing dial depicts the late defensive Reaction that this talent permits.

talent:forge-sense.name: Forge-Sense
talent:forge-sense.reason: The worked sharpening stone evokes judging a weapon by handling its craft.

talent:frenzy.name: Frenzy
talent:frenzy.reason: Retain: the protective frenzy creature image matches Rage held through a dangerous round.

talent:frost-armor.name: Frost Armor

talent:frostbolt.name: Frostbolt
talent:frostbolt.reason: Align with the named Frostbolt spell: A long blue shard points toward its target. Frostbolt throws a shard of ice and spreads cold at impact, matching the projectile.

talent:frostwolf-ways.name: Frostwolf Ways
talent:frostwolf-ways.reason: The white wolf depicts a wolf that can serve as a mount.

talent:frozen-core.name: Frozen Core
talent:frozen-core.reason: Retain: the frozen core image depicts Frost immunity and empowered Frost damage.

talent:gadgeteer.reason: Replace: Eviscerate depicts a rogue blade strike. The engineering gears depict choosing and using a roster of gadgets.

talent:garrote.name: Garrote
